visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The animation begins on a stark white background. Bold black Traditional Chinese and English text at the top instructs viewers to 'Place your finger here on the screen,' accompanied by a dashed outline of a finger. A small, yellow cartoon cat with a grumpy expression and pointed ears sits on the left, rendered in a simple 2D hand-drawn style. (2) The yellow cat moves toward the dashed line representing the viewer's finger. Its facial expression shifts from a neutral frown to a blissful squint with pink blush appearing on its cheeks, mimicking the visual reaction to being petted. The environment remains a clean, white digital space with flat lighting. (3) A round black cat with large, circular yellow eyes enters. It looks up curiously at the interaction point. As it 'receives' pets, its eyes narrow into happy slits and small pink hearts float around its head, signifying affection in a minimalist setting. (4) A calico cat with a distinctive heart-shaped patch on its forehead appears. It initially shows wide-eyed surprise with dilated pupils before transitioning to a serene, eyes-closed state of enjoyment. No other objects are present in the frame. (5) A ginger tabby cat leans into the dashed finger outline. A stream of blue digital liquid flows from the finger into its mouth. The cat then rolls onto its back in a playful, high-energy movement sequence against the static white background.
